an10.267-746:1.1: “Bhikkhus, for direct knowledge … for full understanding … for the utter destruction … for the abandoning … for the destruction … for the vanishing … for the fading away … for the cessation … for the giving up … for the relinquishment of hatred …
an10.267-746:1.25: these ten things are to be developed.” This is what the Blessed One said. Elated, those bhikkhus delighted in the Blessed One’s statement.
an10.267-746:1.28: The Book of the Tens is finished.
